research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Roblox is researching simulation and presentation of shared 3D experiences, such as in Primal solver for simulation and display of rigid bodies in a virtual and Simulation of rigid bodies, plus scalable fluid and aerodynamic models for real-time distributed physics. Work like Automatic personalized avatar generation from 2d images, Dynamic head generation for animation, Hair design and rendering, Layered clothing that conforms to an underlying body and/or clothing layer, and Optimized player positioning system in virtual experiences advances avatar realism, user safety, accessibility, content moderation, adaptive voice and translation, recommendations, and interactive digital advertising within virtual experiences. Together these efforts span physics engines, avatar systems, safety and moderation, personalization, networking, and monetization in virtual environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Roblox operates an online platform for user-generated games and immersive 3D experiences.

product.name: Roblox Platform
product.description: An online platform for creating, discovering, and participating in user-generated games and immersive 3D experiences across supported devices.

product.name: Roblox Studio
product.description: A development environment for building, scripting, testing, and publishing Roblox games and other interactive 3D experiences.

product.name: Roblox Creator Hub
product.description: A web-based suite of tools for managing Roblox experiences, teams, analytics, publishing, monetization, moderation, and creator revenue.

product.name: Roblox Marketplace and Creator Store
product.description: Digital marketplaces for discovering, purchasing, creating, and selling avatar items, virtual assets, models, plugins, and other creator content.

product.name: Roblox Virtual Economy
product.description: A digital commerce system centered on Robux that supports virtual item purchases, in-experience transactions, subscriptions, paid access, and creator payouts.

product.name: Roblox Advertising and Brand Experiences
product.description: Advertising and branded-experience services that let advertisers reach Roblox audiences through immersive ads, sponsored experiences, search placements, video ads, and homepage campaigns.
